name: Spatter
author: E. T. Carter
description: Thrown paint on a dark wall: a dense, clumping field of ragged-edged splats, each flanked by a spray of satellite droplets and trailing a thin drip, in palette hues chosen by position. Splats flare on impact then settle into slow-fading stains so many coexist as built-up texture, clumping heavier off-centre.

params.label: Splat rate
params.effect: How fast new splats land across the field, from an occasional throw to a constant overlapping barrage.

params.label: Splat size
params.effect: Radius in CSS pixels of each splat, its satellite spray and drip, from fine flecks to fat heavy blots.

params.label: Drip
params.effect: Distance in CSS pixels each splat drips downward; 0 makes paint stay where it lands, high values leave long running drips.

params.label: Coverage
params.effect: How densely the paint clumps across the frame, from a sparse scatter to a heavily built-up wall.
